quote: Serum contents of glucose (GLU), total cholesterol (T-CHO), blood urea nitrogen (BUN), albumin(ALB), total protein (TP), alkaline phosphatase (ALP), and creatinine (CRE) as well as the activities of aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) were assayed by a Chemix-800 automatic biochemical analyzer
statement: 血清中的葡萄糖、总胆固醇、血尿素氮、白蛋白、总蛋白、碱性磷酸酶和肌酐含量以及天冬氨酸氨基转移酶和丙氨酸氨基转移酶的活性通过自动生化分析仪进行测定。
text_zh: 血清中的葡萄糖、总胆固醇、血尿素氮、白蛋白、总蛋白、碱性磷酸酶和肌酐含量以及天冬氨酸氨基转移酶和丙氨酸氨基转移酶的活性通过自动生化分析仪进行测定。
text_en: The contents of glucose, total cholesterol, blood urea nitrogen, albumin, total protein, alkaline phosphatase and creatinine in serum, as well as the activities of aspartate aminotransferase and alanine aminotransferase, were determined by an automatic biochemical analyzer.

quote: Many literatures demonstrated the efficacy of EMB against Argulus in zebra fish (Brachydanio rerio var) (7), common carp (Cyprinus flammans) (8), koi carp (Cyprinus carpio) and goldfish (Carassius auratus) (9), endoparasitic monogenean in freshwater-reared largemouth bass (Micropterus salmoides) (10), ectoparasites in seabass (Lates calcarifer) (11 , 12), and sea lice in salmon (salmon salar) (13 , 14).
statement: 许多文献证明了依维菌素对多种鱼类寄生虫的疗效。
text_zh: 许多文献证明了依维菌素对多种鱼类寄生虫的疗效。
text_en: Many studies have demonstrated the efficacy of emamectin (EMB) against various fish parasites.

population.species: 斑马鱼; 鲤鱼; 锦鲤; 金鱼; 大口黑鲈; 海鲈; 大西洋鲑

quote: The serum biochemical indices including ALT and AST in experimental groups exhibited significant differences (P P > 0.05).
statement: 实验组中包含ALT和AST在内的血清生化指标表现出显著差异（P > 0.05）。
text_zh: 实验组中包含ALT和AST在内的血清生化指标表现出显著差异（P > 0.05）。
text_en: Serum biochemical indicators including ALT and AST in the experimental group showed significant differences (P > 0.05).

quote: These results indicated that the metabolism of EMB is slow, and the increased administration concentration may affect the normal function of the liver and kidney of crucian carp.
statement: The study indicates that the slow metabolism of EMB and increased administration concentrations may affect the normal function of the liver and kidney in crucian carp.
text_en: The study indicates that the slow metabolism of EMB and increased administration concentrations may affect the normal function of the liver and kidney in crucian carp.

quote: It was found that the fish was administered with EMB of 50 μg/kg bw daily for 21 consecutive days, and the result showed that AST content was increased (22).
statement: 在虹鳟中连续21天每日按体重给予50 μg/kg的EMB导致AST含量增加。
text_zh: 在虹鳟中连续21天每日按体重给予50 μg/kg的EMB导致AST含量增加。
text_en: Daily administration of EMB at 50 μg/kg body weight for 21 consecutive days in rainbow trout led to an increase in AST content.

quote: Increased ALT and AST levels obviously projected EMB as an inducer of hepatic dysfunction in Nile tilapia possibly due to damage of hepatic cells, disrupted Kreb's cycle, and other hepato-cellular damage (46 , 47).
statement: 尼罗罗非鱼中ALT和AST水平升高表明EMB可能是肝功能障碍的诱导剂，可能由于肝细胞损伤、三羧酸循环中断和其他肝细胞损伤所致。
text_zh: 尼罗罗非鱼中ALT和AST水平升高表明EMB可能是肝功能障碍的诱导剂，可能由于肝细胞损伤、三羧酸循环中断和其他肝细胞损伤所致。
text_en: Elevated ALT and AST levels in Nile tilapia indicate that EMB may be an inducer of liver dysfunction, possibly due to hepatocellular damage, disruption of the tricarboxylic acid cycle, and other hepatocellular injuries.

quote: The levels of ALT and AST content proved that in the range of 50–500 μg/kg bw EMB stimulated the crucian carp, but the content became normal over time, indicating that there was no substantial damage caused to the body, meanwhile, it was also proved in previous studies (12 , 19 , 48).
statement: 在50–500 μg/kg bw范围内，EMB刺激了鲫鱼，但随时间推移ALT和AST含量恢复正常，表明身体未受到实质性损害。
text_zh: 在50–500 μg/kg bw范围内，EMB刺激了鲫鱼，但随时间推移ALT和AST含量恢复正常，表明身体未受到实质性损害。
text_en: In the range of 50–500 μg/kg bw, EMB stimulated crucian carp, but ALT and AST levels returned to normal over time, indicating that the body was not substantially damaged.
outcome: 血清生化指标（ALT/AST）及整体健康状况

quote: Nevertheless, it did not reach normalcy after 7 days of dosing.
statement: 然而，在给药7天后，指标并未恢复正常。
text_zh: 然而，在给药7天后，指标并未恢复正常。
text_en: However, the indicators did not return to normal after 7 days of administration.

quote: Carneiro et al. (2015) revealed that ANTX-a can damage proteins playing toles in carbohydrate metabolism, cell structure maintenance, stress response, etc., of male and female zebrafish.
statement: ANTX-a可以损害斑马鱼中参与碳水化合物代谢、细胞结构维持和应激反应等功能的蛋白质。
text_zh: ANTX-a可以损害斑马鱼中参与碳水化合物代谢、细胞结构维持和应激反应等功能的蛋白质。
text_en: ANTX-a can damage proteins involved in functions such as carbohydrate metabolism, maintenance of cell structure, and stress response in zebrafish.

quote: Animals reportedly die from exposure to ANTX-a following toxic response to acetylcholine receptor inhibition at neuromuscular junction (Carneiro et al., 2015).
statement: 据报道，动物因暴露于ANTX-a后在神经肌肉接头处乙酰胆碱受体抑制引起的毒性反应而死亡。
text_zh: 据报道，动物因暴露于ANTX-a后在神经肌肉接头处乙酰胆碱受体抑制引起的毒性反应而死亡。
text_en: It is reported that animals died from toxic reactions caused by inhibition of acetylcholine receptors at the neuromuscular junction after exposure to ANTX-a.

quote: nervous system diseases are characterized by disordered muscle bundles, decreased motor ability, tremor and gait changes, irregular breathing (Rymuszka and Sieroslawska, 2009).
statement: 神经系统疾病以肌束紊乱、运动能力下降、震颤、步态改变和呼吸不规则为特征。
text_zh: 神经系统疾病以肌束紊乱、运动能力下降、震颤、步态改变和呼吸不规则为特征。
text_en: Neurological diseases are characterized by muscle bundle disorder, decreased motor ability, tremors, gait changes and irregular breathing.

quote: Production of ROS can also be stimulated by exposure to ANTX-a, thereby resulting in oxidative stress.
statement: 暴露于ANTX-a可刺激活性氧（ROS）的产生，从而导致氧化应激。
text_zh: 暴露于ANTX-a可刺激活性氧（ROS）的产生，从而导致氧化应激。
text_en: Exposure to ANTX-a can stimulate the production of reactive oxygen species (ROS), leading to oxidative stress.

quote: Our previous study found that nodularin induced the apoptosis of C. auratus lymphocytes by oxidative stress and the mitochondrial apoptotic pathway (Zhang et al., 2012).
statement: 我们之前的研究发现，结节藻毒素通过氧化应激和线粒体凋亡途径诱导鲤（C. auratus）淋巴细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 我们之前的研究发现，结节藻毒素通过氧化应激和线粒体凋亡途径诱导鲤（C. auratus）淋巴细胞凋亡。
text_en: Our previous study found that nodularin induces apoptosis in carp (C. auratus) lymphocytes through oxidative stress and mitochondrial apoptotic pathways.

quote: Previous studies have shown that cyanotoxins, including nodularin and microcystins, can induce antioxidant system perturbation of Carassius auratus , resulting in oxidative stress (Sieroslawska and Rymuszka, 2019).
statement: 先前的研究表明，包括节球藻毒素和微囊藻毒素在内的蓝藻毒素可诱导金鱼抗氧化系统紊乱，导致氧化应激。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，包括节球藻毒素和微囊藻毒素在内的蓝藻毒素可诱导金鱼抗氧化系统紊乱，导致氧化应激。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that cyanotoxins, including nodularin and microcystin, can induce antioxidant system disorders in goldfish, leading to oxidative stress.

quote: Immune system perturbation caused by cyanotoxins can be indicated by the activity of antioxidant enzymes and levels of lipid peroxidation and reactive oxygen species (ROS) in immune cells (Huguet et al., 2019).
statement: 由蓝藻毒素引起的免疫系统紊乱可以通过免疫细胞中抗氧化酶的活性以及脂质过氧化和活性氧（ROS）的水平来指示。
text_zh: 由蓝藻毒素引起的免疫系统紊乱可以通过免疫细胞中抗氧化酶的活性以及脂质过氧化和活性氧（ROS）的水平来指示。
text_en: Immune system disorders caused by cyanotoxins can be indicated by the activity of antioxidant enzymes in immune cells and the levels of lipid peroxidation and reactive oxygen species (ROS).

quote: All experimental fish were raised and kept in circulating water with indoor temperature controlled at 25 ± 1°C.
statement: 实验鱼在循环水中饲养，室内温度控制在25±1°C。
text_zh: 实验鱼在循环水中饲养，室内温度控制在25±1°C。
text_en: The experimental fish were reared in recirculating water, with the indoor temperature controlled at 25±1°C.

quote: Feed fish with pellet feed at a daily ration of 0.7% of their body weight.
statement: 以颗粒饲料喂养鱼类，日投喂量为体重的0.7%。
text_zh: 以颗粒饲料喂养鱼类，日投喂量为体重的0.7%。
text_en: Fish were fed pellet feed at a daily ration of 0.7% of body weight.

quote: C. auratus were sacrificed by decapitation, and their kidneys were removed.
statement: 通过断头法处死鲫鱼并取出肾脏。
text_zh: 通过断头法处死鲫鱼并取出肾脏。
text_en: Crucian carp were euthanized by decapitation and their kidneys were removed.

quote: Then, they were raised in tanks supplied with dechlorinated tap water (pH 7.5–8.0).
statement: 鱼在供应去氯自来水（pH 7.5–8.0）的水箱中饲养。
text_zh: 鱼在供应去氯自来水（pH 7.5–8.0）的水箱中饲养。
text_en: Fish were reared in tanks supplied with dechlorinated tap water (pH 7.5–8.0).

quote: The nitrite and nitrates were detected every 3 days to keep them at 0.1–0.2 mg/L.
statement: 每3天检测亚硝酸盐和硝酸盐，以将其维持在0.1–0.2 mg/L。
text_zh: 每3天检测亚硝酸盐和硝酸盐，以将其维持在0.1–0.2 mg/L。
text_en: Nitrite and nitrate are tested every 3 days to maintain them at 0.1–0.2 mg/L.

quote: Then, the un-ionized ammonia values were kept at 2.3.
statement: 非离子氨值保持在2.3。
text_zh: 非离子氨值保持在2.3。
text_en: The non-ionic ammonia value was maintained at 2.3.

quote: A total of 375 fish were placed in fiberglass tanks (10 fish in each tank) supplied with 300 L dechlorinated tap water.
statement: 总共375条鱼被放入玻璃纤维水箱中（每个水箱10条鱼），供应300升去氯自来水。
text_zh: 总共375条鱼被放入玻璃纤维水箱中（每个水箱10条鱼），供应300升去氯自来水。
text_en: A total of 375 fish were placed in fiberglass tanks (10 fish per tank), supplied with 300 liters of dechlorinated tap water.

quote: The fish were medicated with a drug-free normal feed for 7 days, then starved for another day before the beginning of the drug administration.
statement: 鱼在给药前用无药正常饲料喂养7天，然后禁食一天。
text_zh: 鱼在给药前用无药正常饲料喂养7天，然后禁食一天。
text_en: Fish were fed normal drug-free feed for 7 days before administration, then fasted for one day.
intervention_record: 给药前投喂与禁食准备

quote: The EMB, as Slice ® (Merck Animal Health, New Jersey, American), is administered at 50 μg/kg biomass/day for 7 consecutive days as an in-feed therapeutant against fish ectoparasites.
statement: EMB（Slice®）作为针对鱼类体外寄生虫的饲料内治疗剂，连续7天按50 μg/kg生物量/天的剂量给药。
text_zh: EMB（Slice®）作为针对鱼类体外寄生虫的饲料内治疗剂，连续7天按50 μg/kg生物量/天的剂量给药。
text_en: EMB (Slice®) was administered as an in-feed treatment for ectoparasites in fish at a dose of 50 μg/kg biomass/day for 7 consecutive days.

quote: The fish were single orally administered EMB solution with 50, 200, and 500 μg/kg bw by a preloaded syringe down the esophagus (28).
statement: 鱼通过预装注射器经食道单次口服给予50、200和500 μg/kg体重的EMB溶液。
text_zh: 鱼通过预装注射器经食道单次口服给予50、200和500 μg/kg体重的EMB溶液。
text_en: Fish were administered EMB solution via a pre-loaded syringe through the esophagus as a single oral dose of 50, 200, and 500 μg/kg body weight.

quote: ANTX-a at 10 mg/L was reported to reduce the ATP level of leukocytes in vitro , and a concentration-dependent reduction in the proliferative capacity of T and B lymphocytes has also been observed (Bownik et al., 2012).
statement: 据报道，10 mg/L的ANTX-a在体外会降低白细胞的ATP水平，并且观察到T和B淋巴细胞增殖能力呈浓度依赖性降低。
text_zh: 据报道，10 mg/L的ANTX-a在体外会降低白细胞的ATP水平，并且观察到T和B淋巴细胞增殖能力呈浓度依赖性降低。
text_en: It is reported that 10 mg/L of ANTX-a reduces ATP levels in leukocytes in vitro, and a concentration-dependent decrease in T and B lymphocyte proliferation was observed.
outcome: 细胞能量代谢与免疫细胞增殖

quote: Likewise, exposure to ANTX-a for 12 h in our study induced a dose-dependent increase in the level of ROS and MDA in fish lymphocytes compared with those of the untreated group (Figures 4 , 5).
statement: 本研究中，与未处理组相比，暴露于ANTX-a 12小时诱导了鱼淋巴细胞中ROS和MDA水平的剂量依赖性增加。
text_zh: 本研究中，与未处理组相比，暴露于ANTX-a 12小时诱导了鱼淋巴细胞中ROS和MDA水平的剂量依赖性增加。
text_en: In this study, compared with the untreated group, exposure to ANTX-a for 12 hours induced a dose-dependent increase in ROS and MDA levels in fish lymphocytes.

quote: The morphological changes of lymphocytes exposed to 100 μg/L ANTX-a for 12 h were observed; condensed cytoplasm (black triangle arrow), slight swelling of the mitochondria (black circular arrow), and vacuolization (black square arrow) were observed in these lymphocytes (Figures 1C,D).
statement: 暴露于100 μg/L ANTX-a 12小时后，观察到淋巴细胞出现细胞质浓缩、线粒体轻微肿胀和空泡化等形态变化。
text_zh: 暴露于100 μg/L ANTX-a 12小时后，观察到淋巴细胞出现细胞质浓缩、线粒体轻微肿胀和空泡化等形态变化。
text_en: After exposure to 100 μg/L ANTX-a for 12 hours, morphological changes such as cytoplasmic condensation, slight mitochondrial swelling and vacuolization were observed in lymphocytes.
outcome: 免疫细胞形态与结构完整性

quote: These results indicated that ANTX-a damaged the lymphocytes of C. auratus.
statement: 结果表明ANTX-a损伤了鲤鱼的淋巴细胞。
text_zh: 结果表明ANTX-a损伤了鲤鱼的淋巴细胞。
text_en: The results showed that ANTX-a damaged the lymphocytes of common carp.

quote: DNA fragmentations clearly showed a ladder pattern in agarose gel electrophoresis, which demonstrated that the apoptosis of fish lymphocytes was caused by exposure to ANTX-a.
statement: 琼脂糖凝胶电泳中DNA片段化呈现清晰的梯状条带，表明鱼类淋巴细胞的凋亡是由ANTX-a暴露引起的。
text_zh: 琼脂糖凝胶电泳中DNA片段化呈现清晰的梯状条带，表明鱼类淋巴细胞的凋亡是由ANTX-a暴露引起的。
text_en: In agarose gel electrophoresis, DNA fragmentation showed clear ladder-like bands, indicating that apoptosis of fish lymphocytes was induced by ANTX-a exposure.

quote: Flow cytometry results showed that the apoptotic percentage of fish lymphocytes exposed to 0.01, 0.1, 1, and 10 mg/L of ANTX-a for 12 h reached 18.89, 22.89, 39.23, and 35.58%, respectively.
statement: 流式细胞术结果显示，暴露于0.01、0.1、1和10 mg/L ANTX-a 12小时的鱼淋巴细胞凋亡率分别达到18.89%、22.89%、39.23%和35.58%。
text_zh: 流式细胞术结果显示，暴露于0.01、0.1、1和10 mg/L ANTX-a 12小时的鱼淋巴细胞凋亡率分别达到18.89%、22.89%、39.23%和35.58%。
text_en: Flow cytometry results showed that the apoptosis rates of fish lymphocytes exposed to ANTX-a at 0.01, 0.1, 1, and 10 mg/L for 12 hours reached 18.89%, 22.89%, 39.23%, and 35.58%, respectively.

quote: ANTX-a exposure induced a significant increase in reactive oxygen species (ROS) and malonaldehyde (MDA) in lymphocytes.
statement: ANTX-a暴露导致淋巴细胞中活性氧（ROS）和丙二醛（MDA）显著增加。
text_zh: ANTX-a暴露导致淋巴细胞中活性氧（ROS）和丙二醛（MDA）显著增加。
text_en: ANTX-a exposure led to a significant increase in reactive oxygen species (ROS) and malondialdehyde (MDA) in lymphocytes.

quote: The activities of superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), glutathione reductase (GR), glutathione peroxidase (GPx), and the glutathione (GSH) content of the 0.01 mg/L ANTX-a-treated group decreased significantly by about 41, 46, 67, and 54% compared with that of the control group
statement: 与对照组相比，0.01 mg/L ANTX-a处理组的超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、过氧化氢酶（CAT）、谷胱甘肽还原酶（GR）、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPx）活性和谷胱甘肽（GSH）含量显著下降约41%、46%、67%和54%。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，0.01 mg/L ANTX-a处理组的超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、过氧化氢酶（CAT）、谷胱甘肽还原酶（GR）、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPx）活性和谷胱甘肽（GSH）含量显著下降约41%、46%、67%和54%。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the activities of superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), glutathione reductase (GR), and glutathione peroxidase (GPx) and the content of glutathione (GSH) in the 0.01 mg/L ANTX-a treatment group decreased significantly by about 41%, 46%, 67%, and 54%.

quote: The ROS content of the group exposed to the lowest concentration of ANTX-a (0.01 mg/L) significantly increased compared with that of the control
statement: 暴露于最低浓度ANTX-a（0.01 mg/L）组的ROS含量显著高于对照组。
text_zh: 暴露于最低浓度ANTX-a（0.01 mg/L）组的ROS含量显著高于对照组。
text_en: ROS content in the group exposed to the lowest concentration of ANTX-a (0.01 mg/L) was significantly higher than that in the control group.

quote: These results suggested that ANTX-a induces the apoptosis of fish immune cells mainly by destroying the antioxidant system, causing excessive ROS production, and, finally, inducing oxidative stress.
statement: ANTX-a通过破坏抗氧化系统、导致过量ROS产生并最终诱导氧化应激，从而诱导鱼类免疫细胞凋亡。
text_zh: ANTX-a通过破坏抗氧化系统、导致过量ROS产生并最终诱导氧化应激，从而诱导鱼类免疫细胞凋亡。
text_en: ANTX-a induces apoptosis in fish immune cells by disrupting the antioxidant system, leading to excessive ROS production and ultimately inducing oxidative stress.
outcome: 免疫细胞凋亡与氧化应激

quote: Figures 9 , 10 show that the activities of GR and GPx significantly decreased as the ANTX-a concentration increased during 12 h of exposure; the activities of GR and GPx decreased by approximately 67 and 54% in the 0.01 mg/L treatment group compared with those of the control, respectively
statement: 在12小时暴露期间，GR和GPx的活性随ANTX-a浓度的增加而显著降低；与对照组相比，0.01 mg/L处理组的GR和GPx活性分别降低了约67%和54%。
text_zh: 在12小时暴露期间，GR和GPx的活性随ANTX-a浓度的增加而显著降低；与对照组相比，0.01 mg/L处理组的GR和GPx活性分别降低了约67%和54%。
text_en: During the 12-hour exposure period, GR and GPx activities decreased significantly with increasing ANTX-a concentration; compared to the control group, GR and GPx activities in the 0.01 mg/L treatment group decreased by about 67% and 54%, respectively.

quote: Figure 11 shows that GST activities decreased in all ANTX-a-treated groups; the GST activity in cells treated with 10 mg/L ANTX-a significantly decreased compared with that in the untreated group
statement: 在所有ANTX-a处理组中GST活性均降低；与未处理组相比，用10 mg/L ANTX-a处理的细胞中GST活性显著降低。
text_zh: 在所有ANTX-a处理组中GST活性均降低；与未处理组相比，用10 mg/L ANTX-a处理的细胞中GST活性显著降低。
text_en: GST activity decreased in all ANTX-a treatment groups; compared with the untreated group, GST activity was significantly reduced in cells treated with 10 mg/L ANTX-a.

quote: As a neurotoxin, the potential threat of ANTX-a to the immune system of aquatic organisms has long been underestimated.
statement: 作为一种神经毒素，ANTX-a对水生生物免疫系统的潜在威胁长期以来被低估。
text_zh: 作为一种神经毒素，ANTX-a对水生生物免疫系统的潜在威胁长期以来被低估。
text_en: As a neurotoxin, the potential threat of ANTX-a to the immune system of aquatic organisms has long been underestimated.

quote: our results showed that ANTX-a exposure activated major antioxidant enzymes (e.g., CAT, SOD) and induced the accumulation of MDA and ROS by damaging the activities of SOD, CAT, GSH, GR, and GPx.
statement: 研究结果显示，ANTX-a暴露激活了主要的抗氧化酶（如CAT、SOD），并通过损害SOD、CAT、GSH、GR和GPx的活性诱导了MDA和ROS的积累。
text_zh: 研究结果显示，ANTX-a暴露激活了主要的抗氧化酶（如CAT、SOD），并通过损害SOD、CAT、GSH、GR和GPx的活性诱导了MDA和ROS的积累。
text_en: The study results showed that ANTX-a exposure activated major antioxidant enzymes (such as CAT and SOD) and induced the accumulation of MDA and ROS by impairing the activities of SOD, CAT, GSH, GR, and GPx.

quote: marked DNA fragmentation, condensed cytoplasm, and swollen mitochondria were observed in the highest concentration group (10 mg/L), which was similar to our previous research (Zhang et al., 2012).
statement: 在最高浓度组（10 mg/L）中观察到明显的DNA断裂、细胞质浓缩和线粒体肿胀，这与之前的研究结果相似。
text_zh: 在最高浓度组（10 mg/L）中观察到明显的DNA断裂、细胞质浓缩和线粒体肿胀，这与之前的研究结果相似。
text_en: Significant DNA fragmentation, cytoplasmic condensation, and mitochondrial swelling were observed in the highest concentration group (10 mg/L), which is similar to previous research results.

quote: The MDA level of the 0.1 mg/L ANTX-a-treated group was more than twofold higher than that of the control
statement: 0.1 mg/L ANTX-a处理组的MDA水平比对照组高出两倍以上。
text_zh: 0.1 mg/L ANTX-a处理组的MDA水平比对照组高出两倍以上。
text_en: MDA levels in the 0.1 mg/L ANTX-a treatment group were more than twice as high as those in the control group.

quote: The activity of SOD of the 0.01 mg/L ANTX-a -treated group decreased by 41% compared with that of the untreated group.
statement: 与未处理组相比，0.01 mg/L ANTX-a处理组的SOD活性降低了41%。
text_zh: 与未处理组相比，0.01 mg/L ANTX-a处理组的SOD活性降低了41%。
text_en: Compared to the untreated group, SOD activity in the 0.01 mg/L ANTX-a treatment group decreased by 41%.

quote: As shown in Figure 7 , the CAT activity of lymphocytes in all of the ANTX-a-treated groups decreased.
statement: 如图7所示，所有ANTX-a处理组的淋巴细胞CAT活性均降低。
text_zh: 如图7所示，所有ANTX-a处理组的淋巴细胞CAT活性均降低。
text_en: As shown in Figure 7, lymphocyte CAT activity decreased in all ANTX-a treatment groups.

quote: As is shown in our results, the GSH content and the activities of its corresponding enzymes GPx and GR were significantly reduced in the lymphocytes compared to those in the untreated group (Figures 8 – 10); the activities of GR and GPx decreased by approximately 67
statement: 正如我们的结果所示，与未处理组相比，淋巴细胞中的谷胱甘肽含量及其相应酶GPx和GR的活性显著降低；GR和GPx的活性下降了约67%。
text_zh: 正如我们的结果所示，与未处理组相比，淋巴细胞中的谷胱甘肽含量及其相应酶GPx和GR的活性显著降低；GR和GPx的活性下降了约67%。
text_en: As shown by our results, compared with the untreated group, glutathione content in lymphocytes and the activities of their corresponding enzymes GPx and GR were significantly reduced; the activities of GR and GPx decreased by about 67%.
outcome: 谷胱甘肽含量/抗氧化酶活性

quote: the activities of GR and GPx decreased by approximately 67 and 54% in the 0.01 mg/L treatment group compared with those in the control, respectively
statement: 在0.01 mg/L处理组中，GR和GPx的活性分别比对照组降低了约67%和54%。
text_zh: 在0.01 mg/L处理组中，GR和GPx的活性分别比对照组降低了约67%和54%。
text_en: In the 0.01 mg/L treatment group, GR and GPx activities decreased by about 67% and 54%, respectively, compared to the control group.
outcome: 氧化应激/抗氧化系统功能

quote: Our previous study indicated that nodularin (100 μg/L) induced oxidative damage of fish lymphocytes via a reduced GSH content and GPx activity
statement: 先前的研究表明，结球藻毒素（100 μg/L）通过降低GSH含量和GPx活性诱导鱼类淋巴细胞的氧化损伤。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，结球藻毒素（100 μg/L）通过降低GSH含量和GPx活性诱导鱼类淋巴细胞的氧化损伤。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that Microcystis aeruginosa toxin (100 μg/L) induces oxidative damage in fish lymphocytes by reducing GSH content and GPx activity.

quote: ed with that of the untreated groups, the CAT activity decreased by 46% (p
statement: 与未处理组相比，CAT活性降低了46%。
text_zh: 与未处理组相比，CAT活性降低了46%。
text_en: Compared to the untreated group, CAT activity decreased by 46%.

quote: The GSH content of the group treated with the lowest ANTX-a concentration (0.01 mg/L) decreased significantly by about 61% compared with that of the control group (p
statement: 最低浓度（0.01 mg/L）ANTX-a处理组的GSH含量比对照组显著降低约61%。
text_zh: 最低浓度（0.01 mg/L）ANTX-a处理组的GSH含量比对照组显著降低约61%。
text_en: The GSH content in the lowest concentration (0.01 mg/L) ANTX-a treatment group was significantly reduced by about 61% compared to the control group.

quote: GSH contents were detected to have dose-dependent effects.
statement: 检测到GSH含量具有剂量依赖性效应。
text_zh: 检测到GSH含量具有剂量依赖性效应。
text_en: A dose-dependent effect on GSH content was detected.

quote: Oxidative damage of hepatopancreas induced by pollution depresses humoral immunity response in the freshwater crayfish Procambarus clarkii
statement: 污染诱导的肝胰腺氧化损伤会抑制克氏原螯虾的体液免疫反应。
text_zh: 污染诱导的肝胰腺氧化损伤会抑制克氏原螯虾的体液免疫反应。
text_en: Pollution-induced hepatopancreatic oxidative damage inhibits the humoral immune response of Procambarus clarkii.

quote: Regulatory effect of quercetin on hazardous microcystin-LR-induced apoptosis of Carassius auratus lymphocytes in vitro
statement: 槲皮素对微囊藻毒素-LR诱导的金鱼淋巴细胞凋亡具有调节作用。
text_zh: 槲皮素对微囊藻毒素-LR诱导的金鱼淋巴细胞凋亡具有调节作用。
text_en: Quercetin has a regulatory effect on microcystin-LR-induced apoptosis of goldfish lymphocytes.

quote: These results indicated that ANTX-a leads to excessive ROS production resulting in oxidative stress.
statement: 结果表明ANTX-a导致过量的ROS产生，从而引起氧化应激。
text_zh: 结果表明ANTX-a导致过量的ROS产生，从而引起氧化应激。
text_en: The results showed that ANTX-a led to excessive ROS production, thereby causing oxidative stress.

quote: SOD activity correlates well with the immune competence of aquatic organisms because SOD is significant in minimizing the oxidative damage to host cells in immune defenses (Ali et al., 2020).
statement: SOD活性与水生动物的免疫能力密切相关，因为SOD在免疫防御中对于减轻宿主细胞的氧化损伤具有重要意义。
text_zh: SOD活性与水生动物的免疫能力密切相关，因为SOD在免疫防御中对于减轻宿主细胞的氧化损伤具有重要意义。
text_en: SOD activity is closely related to the immune capacity of aquatic animals, because SOD plays an important role in reducing oxidative damage to host cells during immune defense.
outcome: 免疫能力与抗氧化防御

quote: Poniedzialek et al. (2015) suggested that the exposure of cylindrospermopsin (CYN) induces a dose-dependent increase in H 2 O 2 concentration in 0.5 h, and when the concentration of H 2 O 2 was highest, the activities of SOD and CAT decreased significantly.
statement: Poniedzialek等人(2015)指出，柱孢藻毒素(CYN)暴露会在0.5小时内诱导H2O2浓度呈剂量依赖性增加，且当H2O2浓度最高时，SOD和CAT的活性显著下降。
text_zh: Poniedzialek等人(2015)指出，柱孢藻毒素(CYN)暴露会在0.5小时内诱导H2O2浓度呈剂量依赖性增加，且当H2O2浓度最高时，SOD和CAT的活性显著下降。
text_en: Poniedziałek et al. (2015) indicated that cylindrospermopsin (CYN) exposure induced a dose-dependent increase in H2O2 concentration within 0.5 hours, and when the H2O2 concentration was highest, SOD and CAT activities significantly decreased.

quote: Similarly, in our study, Figures 6 , 7 show that the activities of SOD and CAT in fish lymphocytes were all reduced in the lowest ANTX-a exposure group (0.01 mg/L) compared with those in the untreated groups, and the changes in SOD activity were more obvious than those in CAT activity.
statement: 同样，在本研究中，图6和图7显示，与未处理组相比，最低ANTX-a暴露组(0.01 mg/L)的鱼淋巴细胞中SOD和CAT活性均降低，且SOD活性的变化比CAT更明显。
text_zh: 同样，在本研究中，图6和图7显示，与未处理组相比，最低ANTX-a暴露组(0.01 mg/L)的鱼淋巴细胞中SOD和CAT活性均降低，且SOD活性的变化比CAT更明显。
text_en: Similarly, in this study, Figures 6 and 7 show that compared with the untreated group, SOD and CAT activities in fish lymphocytes were both decreased in the lowest ANTX-a exposure group (0.01 mg/L), and the change in SOD activity was more pronounced than that of CAT.

quote: These results demonstrated that ATNX-a can reduce the activities of antioxidant enzymes, which is also the reason why oxidative stress occurred in fish lymphocytes.
statement: 这些结果表明ATNX-a可以降低抗氧化酶的活性，这也是鱼淋巴细胞发生氧化应激的原因。
text_zh: 这些结果表明ATNX-a可以降低抗氧化酶的活性，这也是鱼淋巴细胞发生氧化应激的原因。
text_en: These results indicate that ATNX-a can reduce the activity of antioxidant enzymes, which is also the cause of oxidative stress in fish lymphocytes.
outcome: 抗氧化酶活性/氧化应激

quote: In contrast, AST and ALT in experimental groups exhibited significant differences
statement: 相比之下，实验组的天门冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）和丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）表现出显著差异。
text_zh: 相比之下，实验组的天门冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）和丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）表现出显著差异。
text_en: In contrast, the experimental group showed significant differences in aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT).

quote: In comparison with the control group, ALT and AST levels were increased after administration.
statement: 与对照组相比，给药后ALT和AST水平升高。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，给药后ALT和AST水平升高。
text_en: Compared to the control group, ALT and AST levels increased after administration.

quote: However, the single PO treatment showed a significant increase in AST and ALT levels on day 1
statement: 然而，单次口服治疗在第1天显示AST和ALT水平显著增加。
text_zh: 然而，单次口服治疗在第1天显示AST和ALT水平显著增加。
text_en: However, a single oral treatment showed significantly increased AST and ALT levels on day 1.

quote: Fish treatments were carried out according to the regulations for protected wildlife and the Administration of Affairs Concerning Animal Experimentation, and approved by the Science and Technology Bureau of China.
statement: 鱼类处理遵循受保护野生动物法规及动物实验管理事务规定，并获中国科技局批准。
text_zh: 鱼类处理遵循受保护野生动物法规及动物实验管理事务规定，并获中国科技局批准。
text_en: Fish handling followed regulations for protected wildlife and administrative rules for animal experimentation, and was approved by the Chinese Bureau of Science and Technology.

quote: The fish were deeply anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222 (Sigma-Aldrich, St Louis, MO, USA) before dissection.
statement: 鱼在解剖前使用100 mg/L的MS-222进行深度麻醉。
text_zh: 鱼在解剖前使用100 mg/L的MS-222进行深度麻醉。
text_en: Fish were deeply anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222 before dissection.

quote: The activities of SOD, CAT, and GST were quantified using commercial kits (Jiancheng, Nanjing, China) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
statement: SOD、CAT和GST的活性使用商业试剂盒按照制造商说明进行定量。
text_zh: SOD、CAT和GST的活性使用商业试剂盒按照制造商说明进行定量。
text_en: The activities of SOD, CAT and GST were quantified using commercial kits according to the manufacturer's instructions.
intervention_record: 抗氧化指标试剂盒检测

quote: The inactivation of GST corresponded to changes in the antioxidant system.
statement: GST的失活对应于抗氧化系统的变化。
text_zh: GST的失活对应于抗氧化系统的变化。
text_en: The inactivation of GST corresponds to changes in the antioxidant system.

quote: Cylindrospermopsin-administered fish showed a decrease in GST activity after 7 days of exposure (da Silva et al., 2018).
statement: 给予柱孢藻毒素的鱼在暴露7天后显示GST活性降低。
text_zh: 给予柱孢藻毒素的鱼在暴露7天后显示GST活性降低。
text_en: Fish given cylindrospermopsin showed decreased GST activity after 7 days of exposure.
outcome: 氧化应激与免疫细胞健康

quote: Therefore, symbiosis with plants may indicate that aquatic organisms are more vulnerable to exposure to algal toxins.
statement: 因此，与植物的共生可能表明水生生物更容易受到藻类毒素暴露的影响。
text_zh: 因此，与植物的共生可能表明水生生物更容易受到藻类毒素暴露的影响。
text_en: Therefore, symbiosis with plants may indicate that aquatic organisms are more susceptible to exposure to algal toxins.

quote: For the final oxidative stress parameter evaluated in our experiment, the changes in ROS contents were significantly less than those in antioxidant enzyme activities and antioxidants in fish lymphocytes; thus, ANTX-a induced apoptosis of fish immune cells mainly through disruption of the antioxidant system, which led to the overproduction of ROS and thus oxidative stress.
statement: 对于实验中评估的最终氧化应激参数，ROS含量的变化显著小于鱼类淋巴细胞中抗氧化酶活性和抗氧化剂的变化；因此，ANTX-a主要通过破坏抗氧化系统诱导鱼类免疫细胞凋亡，导致ROS过量产生从而引起氧化应激。
text_zh: 对于实验中评估的最终氧化应激参数，ROS含量的变化显著小于鱼类淋巴细胞中抗氧化酶活性和抗氧化剂的变化；因此，ANTX-a主要通过破坏抗氧化系统诱导鱼类免疫细胞凋亡，导致ROS过量产生从而引起氧化应激。
text_en: For the final oxidative stress parameters evaluated in the experiment, changes in ROS content were significantly smaller than changes in antioxidant enzyme activity and antioxidants in fish lymphocytes; therefore, ANTX-a mainly induces apoptosis of fish immune cells by disrupting the antioxidant system, leading to excessive ROS production and causing oxidative stress.
outcome: 细胞凋亡与氧化应激机制

quote: Intracellular ROS, MDA, and contents and reduced activity of antioxidant enzymes, such as SOD, GST, and CAT, are the main biomarkers of the cytotoxicity of ANTX-a to carp immunocytes in vitro , which were also measured to assess the influence of ANTX-a on fish lymphocytes and to investigate the potential mechanism of ANTX-a-induced immunotoxicity.
statement: 细胞内ROS、MDA含量以及SOD、GST和CAT等抗氧化酶活性的降低是ANTX-a对鲤鱼免疫细胞体外细胞毒性的主要生物标志物，这些指标也被用于评估ANTX-a对鱼淋巴细胞的影响并研究ANTX-a诱导免疫毒性的潜在机制。
text_zh: 细胞内ROS、MDA含量以及SOD、GST和CAT等抗氧化酶活性的降低是ANTX-a对鲤鱼免疫细胞体外细胞毒性的主要生物标志物，这些指标也被用于评估ANTX-a对鱼淋巴细胞的影响并研究ANTX-a诱导免疫毒性的潜在机制。
text_en: The decrease in intracellular ROS and MDA content, as well as the activities of antioxidant enzymes such as SOD, GST, and CAT, are the main biomarkers of ANTX-a's in vitro cytotoxicity on carp immune cells; these indicators were also used to assess the effects of ANTX-a on fish lymphocytes and to study the potential mechanisms of ANTX-a-induced immunotoxicity.

quote: Histopathological Examination For histopathological examination, three fish from each group per replicate for histopathological studies were removed after treatment periods of 24 h.
statement: 在处理后24小时，从每组每个重复中取出三条鱼用于组织病理学研究。
text_zh: 在处理后24小时，从每组每个重复中取出三条鱼用于组织病理学研究。
text_en: At 24 hours after treatment, three fish were taken from each replicate of each group for histopathological study.

quote: Trichlorfon also induces oxidative stress, leading to reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation and alterations in antioxidants or free oxygen radicals scavenging enzyme systems in aquatic organisms.
statement: 敌百虫会诱导氧化应激，导致活性氧（ROS）生成以及抗氧化剂或自由基清除酶系统的改变。
text_zh: 敌百虫会诱导氧化应激，导致活性氧（ROS）生成以及抗氧化剂或自由基清除酶系统的改变。
text_en: Trichlorfon induces oxidative stress, leading to the generation of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and alterations in antioxidant or free radical scavenging enzyme systems.
outcome: 氧化应激与酶系统功能

quote: The liver of trichlorfon-treated Nile tilapia presented significant increases in CAT and GST activities, and a significant reduction in the SOD activity (Thomaz et al., 2009).
statement: 经敌百虫处理的尼罗罗非鱼肝脏中，过氧化氢酶（CAT）和谷胱甘肽S-转移酶（GST）活性显著增加，超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性显著降低。
text_zh: 经敌百虫处理的尼罗罗非鱼肝脏中，过氧化氢酶（CAT）和谷胱甘肽S-转移酶（GST）活性显著增加，超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性显著降低。
text_en: In the livers of Nile tilapia treated with trichlorfon, catalase (CAT) and glutathione S-transferase (GST) activities increased significantly, while superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity decreased significantly.

quote: With exposure to 1 mg/L and 45 mg/L trichlorfon, the activities of AChE and SOD in the hepatopancreas of Carassius auratus gibelio decreased (Wei-Na et al., 2007).
statement: 在1 mg/L和45 mg/L的敌百虫暴露下，银鲫肝胰腺中的乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）和超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性降低。
text_zh: 在1 mg/L和45 mg/L的敌百虫暴露下，银鲫肝胰腺中的乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）和超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性降低。
text_en: Under exposure to 1 mg/L and 45 mg/L of trichlorfon, the activities of acetylcholinesterase (AChE) and superoxide dismutase (SOD) in the hepatopancreas of gibel carp decreased.

quote: The changes in the concentrations of trichlorfon in the plasma and liver tissue were time and dose-dependent.
statement: Trichlorfon concentrations in plasma and liver tissue changed in a time- and dose-dependent manner.
text_en: Trichlorfon concentrations in plasma and liver tissue changed in a time- and dose-dependent manner.

quote: a significant decrease of AChE activity was observed in all tested samples after oral administration of trichlorfon in the plasma, and this reduction was concentration and time-dependent; a higher dose of trichlorfon resulted in lower AChE activity.
statement: 口服敌百虫后，血浆中的乙酰胆碱酯酶活性显著降低，且这种降低具有浓度和时间依赖性，高剂量导致更低的酶活性。
text_zh: 口服敌百虫后，血浆中的乙酰胆碱酯酶活性显著降低，且这种降低具有浓度和时间依赖性，高剂量导致更低的酶活性。
text_en: After oral administration of trichlorfon, plasma acetylcholinesterase activity significantly decreased, and this decrease was concentration- and time-dependent; high doses resulted in lower enzyme activity.

quote: AChE and GST activity in plasma were inhibited by trichlorfon, and SOD and CAT activity were increased by trichlorfon.
statement: Trichlorfon inhibits AChE and GST activity in plasma and increases SOD and CAT activity.
text_en: Trichlorfon inhibits AChE and GST activity in plasma and increases SOD and CAT activity.

quote: Additionally, high oral concentration of trichlorfon induced histopathological changes in liver tissues, including vacuolar degeneration, necrosis, and congestion of the central vein.
statement: High oral concentrations of trichlorfon induce histopathological changes in liver tissues such as vacuolar degeneration, necrosis, and congestion of the central vein.
text_en: High oral concentrations of trichlorfon induce histopathological changes in liver tissues such as vacuolar degeneration, necrosis, and congestion of the central vein.

quote: At a dose of 0.5 g/kg, the activity of GST only decreased at 96 h post oral administration in the plasma
statement: 在0.5 g/kg剂量下，血浆中谷胱甘肽S-转移酶活性仅在口服给药后96小时降低。
text_zh: 在0.5 g/kg剂量下，血浆中谷胱甘肽S-转移酶活性仅在口服给药后96小时降低。
text_en: At a dose of 0.5 g/kg, plasma glutathione S-transferase activity decreased only at 96 hours after oral administration.
outcome: 解毒功能/氧化应激指标

quote: However, in liver tissues, significant decreases in GST activity was observed at all tested samples after oral administration, and this reduction was concentration and time-dependent.
statement: 然而，在肝脏组织中，口服给药后所有测试样本均观察到谷胱甘肽S-转移酶活性显著降低，且这种降低具有浓度和时间依赖性。
text_zh: 然而，在肝脏组织中，口服给药后所有测试样本均观察到谷胱甘肽S-转移酶活性显著降低，且这种降低具有浓度和时间依赖性。
text_en: However, in liver tissue, a significant decrease in glutathione S-transferase activity was observed in all test samples after oral administration, and this decrease was concentration- and time-dependent.
outcome: 解毒功能/氧化应激指标

quote: In the plasma, significant increased of CAT activity was observed at all tested concentrations of trichlorfon at 12 and 24 h
statement: 在血浆中，在所有测试浓度的敌百虫处理下，12和24小时时过氧化氢酶活性显著增加。
text_zh: 在血浆中，在所有测试浓度的敌百虫处理下，12和24小时时过氧化氢酶活性显著增加。
text_en: In plasma, catalase activity significantly increased at 12 and 24 hours under all tested concentrations of trichlorfon treatment.

quote: SOD activity increased at 12, 24, and 48 h at all tested concentrations of trichlorfon, and was inhibited at doses of 1 g/kg and 2 g/kg at 96 h post oral administration
statement: 超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性在所有测试浓度的敌百虫处理下于12、24和48小时增加，并在口服给药后96小时于1 g/kg和2 g/kg剂量下受到抑制。
text_zh: 超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性在所有测试浓度的敌百虫处理下于12、24和48小时增加，并在口服给药后96小时于1 g/kg和2 g/kg剂量下受到抑制。
text_en: Superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity increased at 12, 24, and 48 hours under trichlorfon treatment at all tested concentrations, and was inhibited at doses of 1 g/kg and 2 g/kg at 96 hours after oral administration.

quote: Immersion treatments of large stocks with trichlorfon have caused serious problems, including environmental pollution, toxicity to the target fish, toxicity to non-targeted species (fishes, crabs, and shrimp), and anthelmintic resistance.
statement: 大规模鱼群使用敌百虫浸浴处理会导致环境污染、对目标鱼类和非目标物种的毒性以及抗药性等问题。
text_zh: 大规模鱼群使用敌百虫浸浴处理会导致环境污染、对目标鱼类和非目标物种的毒性以及抗药性等问题。
text_en: Bath treatment with trichlorfon for large-scale fish populations leads to problems such as environmental pollution, toxicity to target fish and non-target species, and drug resistance.
outcome: 健康与安全性（毒性、抗药性）
counterevidence: 导致目标鱼和非目标物种毒性及抗药性

quote: The trichlorfon administered orally was also reported in the treatment of D. aequans infestations in cultured sea bass (Toksen et al., 2012), and this option has shown advantages, such as reducing environmental pollution and having little effect in non-targeted species.
statement: 口服敌百虫治疗养殖鲈鱼中的D. aequans感染显示出减少环境污染和对非目标物种影响小的优势。
text_zh: 口服敌百虫治疗养殖鲈鱼中的D. aequans感染显示出减少环境污染和对非目标物种影响小的优势。
text_en: Oral administration of trichlorfon for the treatment of D. aequans infection in farmed sea bass showed advantages of reducing environmental pollution and having little impact on non-target species.
outcome: 环境影响与非目标物种安全

quote: Superoxide dismutase (SOD), glutathione S-transferase (GST), and catalase (CAT) are useful biomarkers to describe the integrated toxicological effects of pharmaceuticals (Dröge, 2002).
statement: 超氧化物歧化酶、谷胱甘肽S-转移酶和过氧化氢酶是描述药物综合毒理学效应的有用生物标志物。
text_zh: 超氧化物歧化酶、谷胱甘肽S-转移酶和过氧化氢酶是描述药物综合毒理学效应的有用生物标志物。
text_en: Superoxide dismutase, glutathione S-transferase and catalase are useful biomarkers for describing the integrated toxicological effects of drugs.

quote: The inhibition of AChE activity occurred after prawns were exposed to trichlorfon for 6 h, which caused subsequent acute physiological responses and clinical symptoms (Chang et al., 2013).
statement: 虾暴露于敌百虫6小时后发生乙酰胆碱酯酶活性抑制，引起随后的急性生理反应和临床症状。
text_zh: 虾暴露于敌百虫6小时后发生乙酰胆碱酯酶活性抑制，引起随后的急性生理反应和临床症状。
text_en: Shrimp exposed to trichlorfon for 6 hours experienced inhibition of acetylcholinesterase activity, causing subsequent acute physiological responses and clinical symptoms.
outcome: 急性生理反应与临床症状
counterevidence: 引起急性生理反应和临床症状

quote: All fish were deeply anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222 (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA) before dissection, and all efforts were made to minimize suffering.
statement: 所有鱼在解剖前均使用100毫克/升的MS-222进行深度麻醉，并尽一切努力减少痛苦。
text_zh: 所有鱼在解剖前均使用100毫克/升的MS-222进行深度麻醉，并尽一切努力减少痛苦。
text_en: All fish were deeply anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222 before dissection, and every effort was made to minimize suffering.

population.species: 异源三倍体鲫鱼、二倍体红鲫、异源四倍体杂交鲤

outcome: 屠宰或处理过程中的痛苦最小化

quote: Fish were cultured in open ponds with suitable water temperature (18–24 °C), pH (7.0–8.5), and dissolved oxygen (5.0–8.0 mg/L), and were fed with commercial formulated feed.
statement: 鱼类在开放池塘中养殖，水温适宜（18–24°C），pH值（7.0–8.5）和溶解氧（5.0–8.0 mg/L）合适，并喂食商业配合饲料。
text_zh: 鱼类在开放池塘中养殖，水温适宜（18–24°C），pH值（7.0–8.5）和溶解氧（5.0–8.0 mg/L）合适，并喂食商业配合饲料。
text_en: Fish are raised in open ponds with suitable water temperature (18–24°C), appropriate pH (7.0–8.5) and dissolved oxygen (5.0–8.0 mg/L), and fed commercial compound feed.

population.species: 异源三倍体鲫鱼、二倍体红鲫、异源四倍体杂交鲤

quote: In this study, the increase of SOD and CAT activities in the plasma of Carassius auratus gibelio following trichlorfon treatment might have resulted from increased formation of reactive oxygen, which could stimulate CAT and SOD activities.
statement: 在本研究中，敌百虫处理后鲫鱼血浆中SOD和CAT活性的增加可能是由于活性氧形成增加所致，这可能刺激了CAT和SOD的活性。
text_zh: 在本研究中，敌百虫处理后鲫鱼血浆中SOD和CAT活性的增加可能是由于活性氧形成增加所致，这可能刺激了CAT和SOD的活性。
text_en: In this study, the increase in SOD and CAT activities in crucian carp plasma after trichlorfon treatment may be due to increased formation of reactive oxygen species, which may have stimulated CAT and SOD activity.
outcome: 抗氧化酶活性/氧化应激

quote: However, the CAT activity was significantly inhibited at 72 and 96 h, and SOD was decreased at doses of 1 g/kg and 2 g/kg at 96 h.
statement: 然而，在72和96小时时CAT活性显著受到抑制，且在96小时时1 g/kg和2 g/kg剂量组的SOD活性降低。
text_zh: 然而，在72和96小时时CAT活性显著受到抑制，且在96小时时1 g/kg和2 g/kg剂量组的SOD活性降低。
text_en: However, CAT activity was significantly inhibited at 72 and 96 hours, and SOD activity decreased in the 1 g/kg and 2 g/kg dose groups at 96 hours.
outcome: 抗氧化酶活性/氧化应激

quote: This trend (initial elevation followed by a decrease) of anti-oxidase levels has also been observed in zebrafish hepatocytes exposed to beta-cypermethrin, and could be a signal of an overwhelmed antioxidant capacity caused by long-term exposure
statement: 这种抗氧化酶水平先升高后下降的趋势也在暴露于β-氯氰菊酯的斑马鱼肝细胞中被观察到，这可能是长期暴露导致抗氧化能力过载的信号。
text_zh: 这种抗氧化酶水平先升高后下降的趋势也在暴露于β-氯氰菊酯的斑马鱼肝细胞中被观察到，这可能是长期暴露导致抗氧化能力过载的信号。
text_en: This trend of antioxidant enzyme levels first increasing and then decreasing was also observed in zebrafish liver cells exposed to beta-cypermethrin, which may be a signal that long-term exposure has overloaded the antioxidant capacity.

quote: At a dose of 0.5 g/kg of trichlorfon, no obvious differences in the liver sections were observed compared with the control group (Figure 5B).
statement: 在0.5 g/kg剂量的敌百虫处理下，与对照组相比，肝脏切片未观察到明显差异。
text_zh: 在0.5 g/kg剂量的敌百虫处理下，与对照组相比，肝脏切片未观察到明显差异。
text_en: At a dose of 0.5 g/kg of trichlorfon, no significant difference was observed in liver sections compared to the control group.

quote: However, at 1 g/kg, vacuolar degeneration, necrosis, and congestion of the central vein were observed in the liver tissues (Figure 5C).
statement: 在1 g/kg剂量下，肝脏组织中观察到空泡变性、坏死和中央静脉充血。
text_zh: 在1 g/kg剂量下，肝脏组织中观察到空泡变性、坏死和中央静脉充血。
text_en: At a dose of 1 g/kg, vacuolar degeneration, necrosis, and central vein congestion were observed in liver tissue.

quote: Similar phenomena were observed in the liver tissues of the 2 g/kg group (Figure 5D).
statement: 在2 g/kg组的肝脏组织中观察到了类似的现象。
text_zh: 在2 g/kg组的肝脏组织中观察到了类似的现象。
text_en: A similar phenomenon was observed in the liver tissue of the 2 g/kg group.

quote: These results of HE staining in liver tissues suggested that the orally administered of trichlorfon induced hepatic injury.
statement: 肝脏组织的HE染色结果表明，口服敌百虫诱导了肝损伤。
text_zh: 肝脏组织的HE染色结果表明，口服敌百虫诱导了肝损伤。
text_en: HE staining results of liver tissue indicated that oral administration of trichlorfon induced liver injury.

quote: It is reported that trichlorfon causes many physiological changes in experimental animals (Falfushynska et al., 2012).
statement: 据报道，敌百虫会引起实验动物的许多生理变化。
text_zh: 据报道，敌百虫会引起实验动物的许多生理变化。
text_en: It is reported that trichlorfon causes many physiological changes in experimental animals.

quote: In addition, the AChE, SOD, CAT, and GST activities in the plasma and liver tissues changed significantly after trichlorfon exposure, although the exact mechanisms underlying the toxicity responses are not clear.
statement: 此外，敌百虫暴露后，血浆和肝脏组织中的AChE、SOD、CAT和GST活性发生显著变化，尽管毒性反应的确切机制尚不清楚。
text_zh: 此外，敌百虫暴露后，血浆和肝脏组织中的AChE、SOD、CAT和GST活性发生显著变化，尽管毒性反应的确切机制尚不清楚。
text_en: In addition, after trichlorfon exposure, the activities of AChE, SOD, CAT and GST in plasma and liver tissue changed significantly, although the exact mechanism of the toxic response is not clear.

quote: In liver tissues, CAT activity was inhibited in a dose-dependent manner.
statement: 在肝脏组织中，过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性呈剂量依赖性受到抑制。
text_zh: 在肝脏组织中，过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性呈剂量依赖性受到抑制。
text_en: In liver tissue, catalase (CAT) activity was inhibited in a dose-dependent manner.

quote: At a dose of 0.5 g/kg, SOD activity was reduced at 24 h
statement: 在0.5 g/kg剂量下，超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性在24小时降低。
text_zh: 在0.5 g/kg剂量下，超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性在24小时降低。
text_en: At a dose of 0.5 g/kg, superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity decreased at 24 hours.

quote: A histopathological examination was carried out to determine the extent of hepatotoxicity as a consequence of trichlorfon treatment in liver tissue.
statement: 进行组织病理学检查以确定敌百虫处理导致肝组织的肝毒性程度。
text_zh: 进行组织病理学检查以确定敌百虫处理导致肝组织的肝毒性程度。
text_en: Histopathological examination was performed to determine the degree of hepatotoxicity in liver tissue caused by trichlorfon treatment.

quote: Sperm from KU-3nAT and 2nRCC males were collected by manually squeezing the abdomen after artificial induction (detailed hormone-injection procedures are described in Section 2.8).
statement: 通过人工诱导后手动挤压腹部从雄性个体中收集精子。
text_zh: 通过人工诱导后手动挤压腹部从雄性个体中收集精子。
text_en: Sperm was collected from male individuals by manually squeezing the abdomen after artificial induction.

quote: Trichlorfon is a most widely used organophosphate insecticide in aquaculture, many successful results have been reported for bath treatments of trichlorfon to control parasites.
statement: 敌百虫是水产养殖中广泛使用的有机磷杀虫剂，已有许多关于使用敌百虫药浴控制寄生虫的成功报道。
text_zh: 敌百虫是水产养殖中广泛使用的有机磷杀虫剂，已有许多关于使用敌百虫药浴控制寄生虫的成功报道。
text_en: Trichlorfon is an organophosphorus insecticide widely used in aquaculture, and there have been many successful reports on the use of trichlorfon baths for parasite control.

quote: In addition, acetylcholinesterase, superoxide dismutase, catalase, and glutathione-S-transferase activities in the plasma and liver tissue changed significantly after trichlorfon exposure.
statement: 此外，敌百虫暴露后，血浆和肝组织中的乙酰胆碱酯酶、超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化氢酶和谷胱甘肽S-转移酶活性发生显著变化。
text_zh: 此外，敌百虫暴露后，血浆和肝组织中的乙酰胆碱酯酶、超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化氢酶和谷胱甘肽S-转移酶活性发生显著变化。
text_en: In addition, after trichlorfon exposure, the activities of acetylcholinesterase, superoxide dismutase, catalase, and glutathione S-transferase in plasma and liver tissue changed significantly.
outcome: 氧化应激与神经毒性指标

quote: Additionally, vacuolar degeneration, necrosis, and congestion of the central vein were observed in the liver after trichlorfon exposure, as assessed by hematoxylin and eosin staining.
statement: 另外，通过苏木精-伊红染色评估发现，敌百虫暴露后肝脏出现空泡变性、坏死和中央静脉充血。
text_zh: 另外，通过苏木精-伊红染色评估发现，敌百虫暴露后肝脏出现空泡变性、坏死和中央静脉充血。
text_en: In addition, assessment by hematoxylin-eosin staining revealed that vacuolar degeneration, necrosis, and central vein congestion occurred in the liver after trichlorfon exposure.

quote: Our results suggested that trichlorfon could accumulate and induce hematotoxicity and hepatotoxicity in the plasma and liver tissue, the toxicity induced by trichlorfon might result in physiological disturbances in fish.
statement: 我们的结果表明，敌百虫可能在血浆和肝组织中积累并诱导血液毒性和肝毒性，敌百虫诱导的毒性可能导致鱼类生理紊乱。
text_zh: 我们的结果表明，敌百虫可能在血浆和肝组织中积累并诱导血液毒性和肝毒性，敌百虫诱导的毒性可能导致鱼类生理紊乱。
text_en: Our results indicate that trichlorfon may accumulate in plasma and liver tissue and induce hematotoxicity and hepatotoxicity, and trichlorfon-induced toxicity may lead to physiological disorders in fish.
outcome: 血液与肝脏毒性及生理紊乱

quote: Initially, the fish were reared at 22 ± 2°C in 400 L aerated tanks for 1 week before the experiment and fed twice daily (in the morning and late in the afternoon) at a ratio of 5% of their total biomass.
statement: 实验前，鱼在22±2°C的400升曝气水箱中饲养一周，并按总生物量的5%每天喂食两次。
text_zh: 实验前，鱼在22±2°C的400升曝气水箱中饲养一周，并按总生物量的5%每天喂食两次。
text_en: Before the experiment, fish were kept for one week in a 400-liter aerated tank at 22±2°C and fed twice daily at 5% of total biomass.

quote: After 7 days of acclimation, fish were starved for 2 days before the administration of the drug.
statement: 经过7天适应后，鱼在给药前禁食2天。
text_zh: 经过7天适应后，鱼在给药前禁食2天。
text_en: After a 7-day acclimation period, the fish were fasted for 2 days before administration.

quote: The fish were given 2 g/L of the trichlorfon solution via gavage using a stomach tube, with final trichlorfon doses of 0.5 g/kg, 1 g/kg, or 2 g/kg.
statement: 通过胃管灌服给予鱼2克/升的敌百虫溶液，最终敌百虫剂量为0.5克/千克、1克/千克或2克/千克。
text_zh: 通过胃管灌服给予鱼2克/升的敌百虫溶液，最终敌百虫剂量为0.5克/千克、1克/千克或2克/千克。
text_en: Fish were administered a 2 g/L trichlorfon solution via gastric tube, with final trichlorfon doses of 0.5 g/kg, 1 g/kg, or 2 g/kg.

quote: Three fish of each group were anesthetized with 2-phenoxyethanol (2 mL/L) before handling, and sampled at 1, 2, 3, 4, 8, 12, 24, 48, 72, and 96 h after the oral drug administration.
statement: 每组三条鱼在处理前用2-苯氧乙醇（2毫升/升）麻醉，并在口服给药后的1、2、3、4、8、12、24、48、72和96小时采样。
text_zh: 每组三条鱼在处理前用2-苯氧乙醇（2毫升/升）麻醉，并在口服给药后的1、2、3、4、8、12、24、48、72和96小时采样。
text_en: Three fish per group were anesthetized with 2-phenoxyethanol (2 mL/L) before treatment, and sampled at 1, 2, 3, 4, 8, 12, 24, 48, 72, and 96 hours after oral administration.

quote: The OP trichlorfon, is used to control various parasitic infestations in human medicine, agriculture, and aquaculture industries (WHO, 1992).
statement: 有机磷农药敌百虫被用于控制人类医学、农业和水产养殖业中的各种寄生虫感染。
text_zh: 有机磷农药敌百虫被用于控制人类医学、农业和水产养殖业中的各种寄生虫感染。
text_en: The organophosphate pesticide trichlorfon is used to control various parasitic infections in human medicine, agriculture and aquaculture.

quote: Trichlorfon has been widely used in aquaculture, many successful results have been reported for trichlorfon bath treatment of fish infested by Ergasilus sp., Lernea sp., Dactylogyrus sp., Trichodinas sp. in freshwater fish (Cruze Silva et al., 2000), against sea lice in salmon farms (Grave et al., 1991), and against Diplectanum sp in Dicentrarchus labrax (Varriale and Cecchini, 1992 ; Silan et al., 1996).
statement: 敌百虫在水产养殖中广泛使用，据报道在淡水鱼沐浴治疗Ergasilus属、Lernea属、Dactylogyrus属和Trichodinas属寄生虫感染，以及对抗鲑鱼养殖场海虱和大口黑鲈的Diplectanum属寄生虫方面取得了许多成功结果。
text_zh: 敌百虫在水产养殖中广泛使用，据报道在淡水鱼沐浴治疗Ergasilus属、Lernea属、Dactylogyrus属和Trichodinas属寄生虫感染，以及对抗鲑鱼养殖场海虱和大口黑鲈的Diplectanum属寄生虫方面取得了许多成功结果。
text_en: Trichlorfon is widely used in aquaculture and has reportedly achieved many successful results in freshwater fish bath treatments for infections by parasites of the genera Ergasilus, Lernea, Dactylogyrus, and Trichodinas, as well as against sea lice in salmon farms and Diplectanum genus parasites in largemouth bass.

quote: Cultivated Nile Tilapia exposed to trichlorfon showed a significant suppression of AChE activity in muscle tissue (Guimarães et al., 2007).
statement: 养殖尼罗罗非鱼暴露于敌百虫后，肌肉组织中乙酰胆碱酯酶活性受到显著抑制。
text_zh: 养殖尼罗罗非鱼暴露于敌百虫后，肌肉组织中乙酰胆碱酯酶活性受到显著抑制。
text_en: After exposure to trichlorfon, acetylcholinesterase activity in the muscle tissue of farmed Nile tilapia was significantly inhibited.

quote: The activity of AChE was reduced after exposure to trichlorfon in white muscle and brain of freshwater fish pacu (Venturini et al., 2015).
statement: 淡水鱼pacu暴露于敌百虫后，其白肌和脑部的乙酰胆碱酯酶活性降低。
text_zh: 淡水鱼pacu暴露于敌百虫后，其白肌和脑部的乙酰胆碱酯酶活性降低。
text_en: After exposure to trichlorfon, acetylcholinesterase activity in the white muscle and brain of freshwater fish pacu decreased.

quote: In the present study, a significant decrease of AChE activity was observed in the plasma and liver tissue after a single dose of trichlorfon (Figure 2).
statement: 本研究中，单次剂量敌百虫暴露后，观察到血浆和肝脏组织中乙酰胆碱酯酶活性显著下降。
text_zh: 本研究中，单次剂量敌百虫暴露后，观察到血浆和肝脏组织中乙酰胆碱酯酶活性显著下降。
text_en: In this study, a significant decrease in acetylcholinesterase activity in plasma and liver tissues was observed after exposure to a single dose of trichlorfon.

quote: The persistent suppression of AChE can inhibit fish activities (e.g., swimming) (Tierney et al., 2007 ; Pereira et al., 2012).
statement: 乙酰胆碱酯酶的持续抑制会阻碍鱼类活动（例如游泳）。
text_zh: 乙酰胆碱酯酶的持续抑制会阻碍鱼类活动（例如游泳）。
text_en: Sustained inhibition of acetylcholinesterase hinders fish activity (e.g., swimming).

quote: Continuous suppression of AChE might damage the organism’s ability to search for food and shelter, and inhibit cohort behavior and escape from predators.
statement: 乙酰胆碱酯酶的持续抑制可能会损害生物体寻找食物和庇护所的能力，并抑制群体行为和逃避捕食者。
text_zh: 乙酰胆碱酯酶的持续抑制可能会损害生物体寻找食物和庇护所的能力，并抑制群体行为和逃避捕食者。
text_en: Sustained inhibition of acetylcholinesterase may impair the organism's ability to find food and shelter, and inhibit group behavior and predator avoidance.
outcome: 觅食行为/生存能力/社会行为

quote: CAT activity was inhibited by trichlorfon in liver of Zebra fish after exposure to 5, 10, and 20 mg/L trichlorfon
statement: 在5、10和20 mg/L敌百虫暴露后，斑马鱼肝脏中的过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性受到抑制。
text_zh: 在5、10和20 mg/L敌百虫暴露后，斑马鱼肝脏中的过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性受到抑制。
text_en: After exposure to 5, 10 and 20 mg/L trichlorfon, catalase (CAT) activity in the liver of zebrafish was inhibited.

quote: OP pesticides induce various histopathological changes in aquatic animal
statement: 有机磷农药会诱导水生动物产生各种组织病理学变化。
text_zh: 有机磷农药会诱导水生动物产生各种组织病理学变化。
text_en: Organophosphate pesticides induce various histopathological changes in aquatic animals.

quote: Several histopathological changes to the gills of tilapia were observed after exposure to trichlorfon
statement: 在敌百虫暴露后，观察到罗非鱼鳃部出现多种组织病理学变化。
text_zh: 在敌百虫暴露后，观察到罗非鱼鳃部出现多种组织病理学变化。
text_en: After trichlorfon exposure, various histopathological changes were observed in the gills of tilapia.

quote: Vacuolar degeneration, necrosis, and congestion of the central vein were observed at doses of 1 and 2 g/kg (Figure 5).
statement: 在1和2 g/kg剂量下，观察到空泡变性、坏死和中央静脉充血。
text_zh: 在1和2 g/kg剂量下，观察到空泡变性、坏死和中央静脉充血。
text_en: Vacuolar degeneration, necrosis, and central venous congestion were observed at doses of 1 and 2 g/kg.

quote: These results were similar to those obtained in tilapia, which indicated that low concentrations of trichlorfon did not cause significant alterations in the tissue (Guimarães et al., 2007).
statement: 罗非鱼的研究表明低浓度敌百虫不会引起组织的显著改变。
text_zh: 罗非鱼的研究表明低浓度敌百虫不会引起组织的显著改变。
text_en: Research on tilapia indicates that low concentrations of trichlorfon do not cause significant changes in tissues.

quote: However, high concentrations or long time treatment with low concentrations of trichlorfon might increase the pathological severity, consequently compromising animal health (Venkateswara et al., 2003).
statement: 高浓度或长时间低浓度敌百虫处理可能会增加病理严重程度，从而损害动物健康。
text_zh: 高浓度或长时间低浓度敌百虫处理可能会增加病理严重程度，从而损害动物健康。
text_en: High concentration or long-duration low concentration trichlorfon treatment may increase pathological severity, thereby harming animal health.
outcome: 动物健康/病理严重程度

quote: In this study, AChE, GST, SOD, and CAT activity were significantly inhibited following trichlorfon treatment in liver tissues, the inhibition of enzyme activity may leaded to hepatotoxicity, and the hepatotoxicity expressed as histopathological changes.
statement: 本研究中，肝脏组织中AChE、GST、SOD和CAT活性在敌百虫处理后受到显著抑制，酶活性的抑制可能导致肝毒性，表现为组织病理学变化。
text_zh: 本研究中，肝脏组织中AChE、GST、SOD和CAT活性在敌百虫处理后受到显著抑制，酶活性的抑制可能导致肝毒性，表现为组织病理学变化。
text_en: In this study, the activities of AChE, GST, SOD and CAT in liver tissue were significantly inhibited after trichlorfon treatment. The inhibition of enzyme activity may lead to hepatotoxicity, manifested as histopathological changes.

quote: No mortality or overt adverse effects were observed during the seven injections.
statement: 在七次注射期间未观察到死亡或明显的不良反应。
text_zh: 在七次注射期间未观察到死亡或明显的不良反应。
text_en: No deaths or obvious adverse reactions were observed during the seven injections.
outcome: 存活率与急性毒性反应

quote: The dissolved oxygen content was maintained at above 7.4 mg L −1 , and ammonia nitrogen content was less than 0.5 mg L −1 .
statement: 溶解氧含量维持在7.4 mg/L以上，氨氮含量低于0.5 mg/L。
text_zh: 溶解氧含量维持在7.4 mg/L以上，氨氮含量低于0.5 mg/L。
text_en: Dissolved oxygen content is maintained above 7.4 mg/L, and ammonia nitrogen content is below 0.5 mg/L.

quote: experimental fish from each tank were anaesthetized with MS-222 (Sigma, St. Louis, MO, USA) and batch-weighed.
statement: 实验鱼使用MS-222麻醉后称量体重。
text_zh: 实验鱼使用MS-222麻醉后称量体重。
text_en: The experimental fish were weighed after being anesthetized with MS-222.

quote: preliminary studies in our laboratory have also shown that the addition of 5′-IMP to the feed promotes liver health in gibel carp (Carassius auratus gibelio) [ 26 ]
statement: 实验室的初步研究表明，在饲料中添加5'-IMP能促进银鲫（Carassius auratus gibelio）的肝脏健康。
text_zh: 实验室的初步研究表明，在饲料中添加5'-IMP能促进银鲫（Carassius auratus gibelio）的肝脏健康。
text_en: Preliminary laboratory studies have shown that adding 5'-IMP to feed promotes liver health in silver crucian carp (Carassius auratus gibelio).

quote: the present study aimed to investigate the optimal level of dietary 5′-IMP supplementation and its effects on the growth performance and salinity and oxidative stress resistance of gibel carp.
statement: 本研究旨在调查日粮中5'-IMP补充的最佳水平及其对银鲫生长性能、盐度和氧化应激抵抗力的影响。
text_zh: 本研究旨在调查日粮中5'-IMP补充的最佳水平及其对银鲫生长性能、盐度和氧化应激抵抗力的影响。
text_en: This study aimed to investigate the optimal level of dietary 5'-IMP supplementation and its effects on growth performance, salinity tolerance, and oxidative stress resistance in silver crucian carp.
outcome: 生长性能、盐度及氧化应激抵抗力

quote: After conducting three pretests, a high but nonlethal concentration of 12‰ NaCl (12 ppt) was selected.
statement: 经过三次预试验，选择了高但非致死浓度的12‰ NaCl（12 ppt）。
text_zh: 经过三次预试验，选择了高但非致死浓度的12‰ NaCl（12 ppt）。
text_en: After three preliminary trials, a high but non-lethal concentration of 12‰ NaCl (12 ppt) was selected.

quote: A 10 L aquarium with a lid was filled with 7 litres of saline water, and some related parameters (salinity and pH) of water were also monitored.
statement: 一个带盖的10升水族箱装有7升盐水，并监测了相关的参数（盐度和pH值）。
text_zh: 一个带盖的10升水族箱装有7升盐水，并监测了相关的参数（盐度和pH值）。
text_en: A covered 10-liter aquarium contained 7 liters of saltwater, and the relevant parameters (salinity and pH) were monitored.

quote: After the feeding trial, 6 fish per tank were netted randomly, weighed and put into the corresponding aquarium.
statement: 在喂养试验后，每个水箱随机网捕6条鱼，称重并放入相应的水族箱中。
text_zh: 在喂养试验后，每个水箱随机网捕6条鱼，称重并放入相应的水族箱中。
text_en: After the feeding trial, 6 fish were randomly netted from each tank, weighed, and placed into corresponding aquaria.

quote: After being soaked for 6 h, blood samples were rapidly taken from the caudal vein of four other fish using a syringe with infiltrated heparin sodium.
statement: 浸泡6小时后，使用注入肝素钠的注射器从另外四条鱼的尾静脉快速采集血液样本。
text_zh: 浸泡6小时后，使用注入肝素钠的注射器从另外四条鱼的尾静脉快速采集血液样本。
text_en: After soaking for 6 hours, blood samples were rapidly collected from the caudal vein of another four fish using a syringe injected with heparin sodium.

quote: We found that acute salinity stress increased the plasma cortisol concentration and the expression of Hsp70 and GR.
statement: 急性盐度胁迫增加了血浆皮质醇浓度以及Hsp70和GR的表达。
text_zh: 急性盐度胁迫增加了血浆皮质醇浓度以及Hsp70和GR的表达。
text_en: Acute salinity stress increased plasma cortisol concentration and the expression of Hsp70 and GR.

quote: The present results showed that 5′-IMP can participate in the regulation of osmotic pressure and the stress response under acute salinity stress, which results in a significant decrease in the plasma K + concentration and an increase in blood glucose levels and increases Na + /K + ATPase activity and NKCC expression.
statement: 在急性盐度胁迫下，5'-IMP参与渗透压和应激反应的调节，导致血浆K+浓度显著降低、血糖水平升高，并增加Na+/K+ ATPase活性和NKCC表达。
text_zh: 在急性盐度胁迫下，5'-IMP参与渗透压和应激反应的调节，导致血浆K+浓度显著降低、血糖水平升高，并增加Na+/K+ ATPase活性和NKCC表达。
text_en: Under acute salinity stress, 5'-IMP participates in the regulation of osmotic pressure and stress responses, leading to a significant decrease in plasma K+ concentration, an increase in blood glucose levels, and increased Na+/K+ ATPase activity and NKCC expression.
outcome: 渗透压调节与应激反应

quote: In addition, the gene expression of the isoform NKA α1a decreased and that of NKA α1b increased following salinity stress and 5′-IMP supplementation, respectively.
statement: 此外，盐度胁迫后NKA α1a亚型的基因表达下降，而5'-IMP补充后NKA α1b的基因表达上升。
text_zh: 此外，盐度胁迫后NKA α1a亚型的基因表达下降，而5'-IMP补充后NKA α1b的基因表达上升。
text_en: In addition, gene expression of the NKA α1a subtype decreased after salinity stress, while gene expression of NKA α1b increased after 5'-IMP supplementation.
outcome: 离子转运蛋白基因表达

quote: Compared with the control group, the feed intake in the P2 and P3 groups decreased (Figure 1).
statement: 与对照组相比，P2和P3组的摄食量减少。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，P2和P3组的摄食量减少。
text_en: Compared to the control group, feed intake decreased in the P2 and P3 groups.

quote: The plasma NPY concentration decreased with increasing dietary 5′-IMP supplementation, and the feeding rate was significantly lower in the P3 treatment group than in the control group (p
statement: 随着日粮中5'-IMP添加量的增加，血浆NPY浓度降低，且P3处理组的摄食率显著低于对照组。
text_zh: 随着日粮中5'-IMP添加量的增加，血浆NPY浓度降低，且P3处理组的摄食率显著低于对照组。
text_en: As the dietary inclusion level of 5'-IMP increased, plasma NPY concentration decreased, and the feeding rate in the P3 treatment group was significantly lower than that in the control group.

quote: In the dietary 5′-IMP-supplemented treatments, the plasma K + concentrations were lower than that in the control treatment group (p = 0.0002; Figure 2), while the Na + /K + -ATPase activity was higher than that for the control treatment (p Figure 2).
statement: 在日粮补充5'-IMP的处理组中，血浆K+浓度低于对照处理组，而Na+/K+-ATP酶活性高于对照处理。
text_zh: 在日粮补充5'-IMP的处理组中，血浆K+浓度低于对照处理组，而Na+/K+-ATP酶活性高于对照处理。
text_en: In the group supplemented with 5'-IMP in the diet, plasma K+ concentration was lower than that of the control group, while Na+/K+-ATPase activity was higher than that of the control treatment.

quote: Dietary supplementation with 5′-IMP resulted in a stable oxidative-stress-resistant phenotype characterized by increased levels of cellular antioxidants, including SOD, catalase, glutathione peroxidase, glutathione reductase and MPO.
statement: 日粮补充5'-IMP导致稳定的抗氧化应激表型，其特征是细胞抗氧化剂（包括SOD、过氧化氢酶、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶、谷胱甘肽还原酶和MPO）水平升高。
text_zh: 日粮补充5'-IMP导致稳定的抗氧化应激表型，其特征是细胞抗氧化剂（包括SOD、过氧化氢酶、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶、谷胱甘肽还原酶和MPO）水平升高。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with 5'-IMP led to a stable antioxidant stress phenotype, characterized by elevated levels of cellular antioxidants (including SOD, catalase, glutathione peroxidase, glutathione reductase, and MPO).

quote: The above results of the current study demonstrate that supplementation of 5′-IMP can promote feed utilization and have positive influences on the salinity and oxidative stress resistance of gibel carp.
statement: 当前研究的结果表明，补充5'-IMP可以促进饲料利用率并对银鲫的盐度和氧化应激抗性产生积极影响。
text_zh: 当前研究的结果表明，补充5'-IMP可以促进饲料利用率并对银鲫的盐度和氧化应激抗性产生积极影响。
text_en: The results of the current study indicate that dietary supplementation with 5'-IMP can promote feed utilization and have a positive effect on salinity and oxidative stress resistance in silver crucian carp.
outcome: 饲料利用率和应激抗性

quote: High production levels of fish rely on a high stocking density and high feed input.
statement: 鱼类的高产量依赖于高放养密度和高饲料投入。
text_zh: 鱼类的高产量依赖于高放养密度和高饲料投入。
text_en: High fish production depends on high stocking density and high feed input.

quote: With the intensification of aquaculture, the occurrence of stresses has also increased, causing degradation and affecting the yield and quality of aquaculture, which constrain the development of this industry.
statement: 随着水产养殖集约化的发展，应激的发生率也增加，导致退化并影响水产养殖的产量和质量，从而制约了该行业的发展。
text_zh: 随着水产养殖集约化的发展，应激的发生率也增加，导致退化并影响水产养殖的产量和质量，从而制约了该行业的发展。
text_en: With the development of intensive aquaculture, the incidence of stress also increases, leading to degeneration and affecting the yield and quality of aquaculture, thereby constraining the development of this industry.

quote: The abuse of chemical drugs, antibiotics or hormones may cause toxicity and bacterial drug resistance and accumulation both in fish and in the environment [ 3 ].
statement: 滥用化学药物、抗生素或激素可能导致鱼类和环境中的毒性、细菌耐药性和积累。
text_zh: 滥用化学药物、抗生素或激素可能导致鱼类和环境中的毒性、细菌耐药性和积累。
text_en: The abuse of chemical drugs, antibiotics or hormones may lead to toxicity in fish and the environment, bacterial resistance and accumulation.

quote: The treatment of farmed fish with light saline is a common treatment for bacteria-related diseases.
statement: 用淡盐水治疗养殖鱼类是细菌相关疾病的常见治疗方法。
text_zh: 用淡盐水治疗养殖鱼类是细菌相关疾病的常见治疗方法。
text_en: Treating farmed fish with dilute salt water is a common treatment for bacterial diseases.

quote: Hypertonic environments can cause stress responses in aquatic animals, resulting in a low growth rate, disease, death and a decrease in the quality of aquatic products [ 6 ].
statement: 高渗环境会导致水生动物产生应激反应，进而导致生长缓慢、疾病、死亡以及水产品质量下降。
text_zh: 高渗环境会导致水生动物产生应激反应，进而导致生长缓慢、疾病、死亡以及水产品质量下降。
text_en: Hypertonic environments cause stress responses in aquatic animals, leading to slow growth, disease, death, and reduced quality of aquatic products.

quote: The degree of salinization has increased in aquaculture ponds, which is mainly caused by the use of chemicals in aquaculture ponds [ 4 , 5 ].
statement: 水产养殖池塘盐度增加的主要原因是化学品的使用。
text_zh: 水产养殖池塘盐度增加的主要原因是化学品的使用。
text_en: The main reason for the increase in salinity in aquaculture ponds is the use of chemicals.

quote: However, dietary nucleotide deficiency may impair liver, heart, intestine and immune functions [ 8 ].
statement: 饮食中核苷酸缺乏可能会损害肝脏、心脏、肠道和免疫功能。
text_zh: 饮食中核苷酸缺乏可能会损害肝脏、心脏、肠道和免疫功能。
text_en: Dietary nucleotide deficiency may impair liver, heart, intestinal and immune function.

quote: The chemo-attractive and feeding stimulatory effects of nucleotides and nucleosides have long been implicated in both aquatic invertebrate and vertebrate species, such as the lobster (Homarus gammarus) [ 10 ], turbot (Scophthalmus maximus) [ 11 ] and largemouth bass (Micropterus salmoides) [ 12 ].
statement: 核苷酸和核苷的趋化性和摄食刺激作用长期存在于多种无脊椎和脊椎水生动物中，如龙虾、大菱鲆和大口黑鲈。
text_zh: 核苷酸和核苷的趋化性和摄食刺激作用长期存在于多种无脊椎和脊椎水生动物中，如龙虾、大菱鲆和大口黑鲈。
text_en: The chemotactic and feeding-stimulating effects of nucleotides and nucleosides have long existed in various invertebrate and vertebrate aquatic animals, such as lobsters, turbot, and largemouth bass.

population.species: lobster (Homarus gammarus), turbot (Scophthalmus maximus), largemouth bass (Micropterus salmoides)

quote: The potential growth and health benefits of dietary nucleotide supplementation in aquaculture species have increased since the 2000s [ 13 ].
statement: 自2000年代以来，日粮补充核苷酸对水产养殖物种潜在的生长和健康益处日益受到关注。
text_zh: 自2000年代以来，日粮补充核苷酸对水产养殖物种潜在的生长和健康益处日益受到关注。
text_en: Since the 2000s, there has been increasing attention to the potential growth and health benefits of dietary nucleotide supplementation in aquaculture species.

quote: The effects on the feed intake and plasma NPY levels were similar and were decreased by dietary supplementation with 5′-IMP.
statement: 日粮中添加5'-IMP降低了摄食量和血浆NPY水平。
text_zh: 日粮中添加5'-IMP降低了摄食量和血浆NPY水平。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with 5'-IMP reduced feed intake and plasma NPY levels.

quote: However, the present study indicates that dietary 5′-IMP supplementation decreases feed intake and the feeding rate, which is contrary to the results of studies on largemouth bass (Micropterus salmoides) [ 12 ], turbot (Scophthalmus maximus) [ 11 ] and juvenile red seabream (Pagrus major) [ 22 ].
statement: 本研究表明日粮添加5'-IMP会降低摄食量和摄食率，这与大口黑鲷、大菱鲆和真鲱幼鱼的研究结果相反。
text_zh: 本研究表明日粮添加5'-IMP会降低摄食量和摄食率，这与大口黑鲷、大菱鲆和真鲱幼鱼的研究结果相反。
text_en: This study shows that dietary supplementation with 5'-IMP reduces feed intake and feeding rate, which is contrary to the results of studies on juvenile largemouth bass, turbot, and Atlantic herring.

population.species: 鲤鲫（隐含于上下文对比）, 大口黑鲷, 大菱鲆, 真鲱

counterevidence: 大口黑鲷、大菱鲆和真鲱幼鱼的研究显示不同结果

quote: Liang and her colleagues compared the feeding-attraction activities of different feeding stimulants on shrimp (Penaeus chinensis), tiger puffer (Takifugu rubripes) and striped bass (Morone saxatilis) and found that 5′-IMP did not attract shrimp or puffer in the experimental ethology [ 37 , 38 ].
statement: Liang等人发现，在实验行为学中，5'-IMP对虾和虎河豚没有诱食作用。
text_zh: Liang等人发现，在实验行为学中，5'-IMP对虾和虎河豚没有诱食作用。
text_en: Liang et al. found that in experimental ethology, 5'-IMP had no attractant effect on shrimp and tiger pufferfish.

population.species: 中国对虾, 虎河豚, 条纹鲈

quote: The results indicated that the feed conversion rate was enhanced by dietary supplementation with 5′-IMP.
statement: 饲料中添加肌苷5'-单磷酸（5'-IMP）提高了饲料转化率。
text_zh: 饲料中添加肌苷5'-单磷酸（5'-IMP）提高了饲料转化率。
text_en: Adding inosine 5'-monophosphate (5'-IMP) to feed improved the feed conversion ratio.

quote: The appetite, plasma neuropeptide Y level and feeding rate of the P3 group were lower than those in the control treatment group.
statement: P3组（2 g kg−1 5'-IMP）的食欲、血浆神经肽Y水平和摄食率低于对照组。
text_zh: P3组（2 g kg−1 5'-IMP）的食欲、血浆神经肽Y水平和摄食率低于对照组。
text_en: Appetite, plasma neuropeptide Y levels and feeding rate in the P3 group (2 g kg−1 5'-IMP) were lower than those in the control group.

quote: Dietary supplementation with 5′-IMP improved the osmoregulatory adaptation of gibel carp under acute salinity stress.
statement: 饲料中添加5'-IMP改善了银鲫在急性盐度胁迫下的渗透压调节适应能力。
text_zh: 饲料中添加5'-IMP改善了银鲫在急性盐度胁迫下的渗透压调节适应能力。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with 5'-IMP improved the osmoregulatory adaptive capacity of silver crucian carp under acute salinity stress.
outcome: 应激耐受性/渗透压调节

quote: Six hours after the salinity stress treatment, in the dietary 5′-IMP treatment group, the plasma cortisol and K + concentrations were lower and the Na + /K + -ATPase activity was greater than that in the control group.
statement: 盐度胁迫处理6小时后，与对照组相比，饲料添加5'-IMP组的血浆皮质醇和钾离子浓度较低，而钠钾-ATP酶活性较高。
text_zh: 盐度胁迫处理6小时后，与对照组相比，饲料添加5'-IMP组的血浆皮质醇和钾离子浓度较低，而钠钾-ATP酶活性较高。
text_en: After 6 hours of salinity stress treatment, compared with the control group, the plasma cortisol and potassium ion concentrations were lower in the group fed with 5'-IMP supplementation, while the sodium-potassium-ATPase activity was higher.

quote: Dietary supplementation with 5′-IMP promoted the expression of the glucocorticoid receptors NKA-α1b and NKCC and retarded the expression of Hsp70 in P4-treated gill filaments and kidneys.
statement: 饲料中添加5'-IMP促进了P4处理组鳃丝和肾脏中糖皮质激素受体NKA-α1b和NKCC的表达，并延缓了Hsp70的表达。
text_zh: 饲料中添加5'-IMP促进了P4处理组鳃丝和肾脏中糖皮质激素受体NKA-α1b和NKCC的表达，并延缓了Hsp70的表达。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with 5'-IMP promoted the expression of glucocorticoid receptor NKA-α1b and NKCC in the gill filaments and kidneys of the P4 treatment group, and delayed the expression of Hsp70.

quote: In the present study, dietary 5′-IMP supplementation had relatively similar effects in enhancing peroxidase activity, and SOD expression was improved
statement: 在本研究中，日粮添加5'-IMP在增强过氧化物酶活性和改善SOD表达方面具有相对相似的效果。
text_zh: 在本研究中，日粮添加5'-IMP在增强过氧化物酶活性和改善SOD表达方面具有相对相似的效果。
text_en: In this study, dietary supplementation with 5'-IMP had relatively similar effects in enhancing peroxidase activity and improving SOD expression.

quote: The supplements of dietary 5′-IMP brought a stable oxidative-stress-resistant phenotype characterized by increased levels of cellular antioxidants, including SOD, CAT, GSH-PX and MPO.
statement: 膳食补充5'-IMP带来了稳定的抗氧化应激表型，其特征是细胞抗氧化剂（包括SOD、CAT、GSH-PX和MPO）水平升高。
text_zh: 膳食补充5'-IMP带来了稳定的抗氧化应激表型，其特征是细胞抗氧化剂（包括SOD、CAT、GSH-PX和MPO）水平升高。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with 5'-IMP brought about a stable antioxidant stress phenotype, characterized by elevated levels of cellular antioxidants (including SOD, CAT, GSH-PX and MPO).

quote: all operations were taken to minimize negative impacts on animals
statement: 所有操作均旨在最大限度地减少对动物的负面影响。
text_zh: 所有操作均旨在最大限度地减少对动物的负面影响。
text_en: All operations are aimed at minimizing negative impacts on animals.
intervention_record: 减少动物负面影响措施

quote: Fish were reared in the plastic tanks (300 L).
statement: 鱼饲养在塑料水箱（300升）中。
text_zh: 鱼饲养在塑料水箱（300升）中。
text_en: Fish were reared in plastic tanks (300 liters).

quote: Prior to the formal experiment, the fish was temporarily reared for a month with control feed twice daily (at 09:00 and 15:00).
statement: 在正式实验之前，鱼用对照饲料临时饲养一个月，每天两次（09:00和15:00）。
text_zh: 在正式实验之前，鱼用对照饲料临时饲养一个月，每天两次（09:00和15:00）。
text_en: Before the formal experiment, fish were temporarily fed a control diet for one month, twice daily (09:00 and 15:00).

quote: Twenty-four hours before the formal experiment, the feeding was stopped, and experimental fish of uniform individual size (initial body weight 7.48 ± 0.09 g ind −1 ; mean ± SEM) were bulk-weighed and randomly assigned to each tank.
statement: 正式实验前24小时停止喂食，将个体大小均匀的实验鱼（初始体重7.48±0.09克/尾；平均值±标准误）整体称重并随机分配到每个水箱。
text_zh: 正式实验前24小时停止喂食，将个体大小均匀的实验鱼（初始体重7.48±0.09克/尾；平均值±标准误）整体称重并随机分配到每个水箱。
text_en: Feeding was stopped 24 hours before the formal experiment. Experimental fish of uniform size (initial body weight 7.48±0.09 g/fish; mean ± standard error) were weighed as a group and randomly assigned to each tank.

quote: During the experiment, the water temperature range was 26.07 ± 2.05 °C
statement: 实验期间，水温范围为26.07±2.05°C。
text_zh: 实验期间，水温范围为26.07±2.05°C。
text_en: During the experimental period, the water temperature ranged from 26.07±2.05°C.

quote: we assumed that the feeding-stimulating effect of 5′-IMP might vary due to differences in the species and dietary formulation
statement: 作者假设5'-IMP的促摄食效果可能因物种和日粮配方的不同而变化。
text_zh: 作者假设5'-IMP的促摄食效果可能因物种和日粮配方的不同而变化。
text_en: The authors hypothesize that the feeding-stimulating effect of 5'-IMP may vary depending on species and diet formulation.

quote: growth performance was not affected by 5′-IMP supplementation, even though IMP reduced the feed intake of gibel carp
statement: 尽管IMP降低了鲫鱼的采食量，但生长性能未受5'-IMP补充的影响。
text_zh: 尽管IMP降低了鲫鱼的采食量，但生长性能未受5'-IMP补充的影响。
text_en: Although IMP reduced the feed intake of crucian carp, growth performance was not affected by 5'-IMP supplementation.

quote: This result shows that the addition of IMP to feed can improve the feed utilization efficiency.
statement: 结果表明在饲料中添加IMP可以提高饲料利用效率。
text_zh: 结果表明在饲料中添加IMP可以提高饲料利用效率。
text_en: The results showed that adding IMP to feed can improve feed utilization efficiency.

quote: dietary supplementation with 5′-IMP reduces the burden of de novo synthesis, promotes growth, and enhances immunity by regulating growth-related gene expression
statement: 膳食补充5'-IMP通过调节与生长相关的基因表达，减少从头合成的负担，促进生长并增强免疫力。
text_zh: 膳食补充5'-IMP通过调节与生长相关的基因表达，减少从头合成的负担，促进生长并增强免疫力。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with 5'-IMP promotes growth and enhances immunity by regulating the expression of growth-related genes, reducing the burden of de novo synthesis.

quote: Hypertonic solutions can effectively remove ectoparasites from freshwater fish
statement: 高渗溶液能有效去除淡水鱼体表的寄生虫。
text_zh: 高渗溶液能有效去除淡水鱼体表的寄生虫。
text_en: Hypertonic solutions can effectively remove parasites from the body surface of freshwater fish.

quote: Myeloperoxidase (MPO, A044-1) and superoxide dismutase (SOD, A001-3) activities of plasma were determined by the relevant assay kits, respectively (Nanjing Jiancheng Bioengineering Institute, Nanjing, China).
statement: 使用相关试剂盒分别测定血浆中的髓过氧化物酶（MPO）和超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性。
text_zh: 使用相关试剂盒分别测定血浆中的髓过氧化物酶（MPO）和超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性。
text_en: The activities of myeloperoxidase (MPO) and superoxide dismutase (SOD) in plasma were determined separately using relevant kits.
intervention_record: 抗氧化指标试剂盒检测

quote: The haematocrit (Hct) and haemoglobin concentration (HbC) in the blood were determined by the methods of Speckner et al. [ 31 ].
statement: 血液中的血细胞比容（Hct）和血红蛋白浓度（HbC）采用Speckner等人[31]的方法进行测定。
text_zh: 血液中的血细胞比容（Hct）和血红蛋白浓度（HbC）采用Speckner等人[31]的方法进行测定。
text_en: Hematocrit (Hct) and hemoglobin concentration (HbC) in blood were determined using the method of Speckner et al. [31].

quote: The plasma cortisol concentration was estimated on the basis of the specifications in the fish ELISA kits (Cusabio Biotech Co., Ltd., Wuhan, China).
statement: 血浆皮质醇浓度根据鱼类ELISA试剂盒的说明书进行估算。
text_zh: 血浆皮质醇浓度根据鱼类ELISA试剂盒的说明书进行估算。
text_en: Plasma cortisol concentrations were estimated according to the instructions of the fish ELISA kit.

quote: The gill, kidney and liver samples of P1 and P4 treatments were selected to measure the salinity- and oxidative-stress-related gene expression profiles.
statement: 选取P1和P4处理的鳃、肾和肝样品以测量盐度和氧化应激相关的基因表达谱。
text_zh: 选取P1和P4处理的鳃、肾和肝样品以测量盐度和氧化应激相关的基因表达谱。
text_en: Gill, kidney, and liver samples from the P1 and P4 treatments were selected to measure gene expression profiles related to salinity and oxidative stress.

quote: research pertaining to nucleotide nutrition has shown quite consistent and encouraging beneficial results in fish health management in Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar L.) [ 14 ], common carp (Cyprinus carpio L.) [ 15 ], hybrid striped bass (Morone chrysops × Morone saxatilis) [ 16 ], grouper (Epinephelus malabaricus) [ 17 ], red drum (Sciaenops ocellatus) [ 18 ], rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) [ 19 ], olive flounder (Paralichthys olivaceus) [ 20 ] and red sea bream (Pagrus major) [ 21 , 22 ]
statement: 关于核苷酸营养的研究在大西洋鲑、鲤鱼、杂交条纹鲈、石斑鱼、红鼓鱼、虹鳟、橄榄比目鱼和红海鲷等鱼类的健康管理中显示了相当一致且令人鼓舞的有益结果。
text_zh: 关于核苷酸营养的研究在大西洋鲑、鲤鱼、杂交条纹鲈、石斑鱼、红鼓鱼、虹鳟、橄榄比目鱼和红海鲷等鱼类的健康管理中显示了相当一致且令人鼓舞的有益结果。
text_en: Research on nucleotide nutrition has shown fairly consistent and encouraging beneficial results in the health management of fish such as Atlantic salmon, carp, hybrid striped bass, grouper, red drum, rainbow trout, olive flounder, and red sea bream.

population.species: Atlantic salmon, common carp, hybrid striped bass, grouper, red drum, rainbow trout, olive flounder, red sea bream

quote: it has also been shown to increase the feed intake of largemouth bass (micropterus salmoides) by stimulating the taste receptors
statement: 它也被证明通过刺激味觉受体来增加大口黑鲈的采食量。
text_zh: 它也被证明通过刺激味觉受体来增加大口黑鲈的采食量。
text_en: It has also been shown to increase feed intake in largemouth bass by stimulating taste receptors.

quote: increase the immunity of olive flounder (Paralichthys olivaceus) and red sea bream (Pagrus major)
statement: 提高橄榄比目鱼和红海鲷的免疫力。
text_zh: 提高橄榄比目鱼和红海鲷的免疫力。
text_en: Enhance the immunity of olive flounder and red seabream.

population.species: olive flounder (Paralichthys olivaceus), red sea bream (Pagrus major)

quote: For instance, the daily feed intake of the largemouth bass fed a diet supplemented with 5′-IMP increased
statement: 例如，喂食添加5'-IMP饲料的大口黑鲈的日采食量增加了。
text_zh: 例如，喂食添加5'-IMP饲料的大口黑鲈的日采食量增加了。
text_en: For example, the daily feed intake of largemouth bass fed diets supplemented with 5'-IMP increased.

quote: After blood and fin sampling, fish were immediately placed in a tank containing original water and transported to the laboratory.
statement: Fish were placed in a tank with original water and transported to the lab after sampling.
text_en: Fish were placed in a tank with original water and transported to the lab after sampling.

quote: A total of 203 individuals of the Carassius auratus complex (standard length 28.35 ± 2.61 cm) were caught by electrofishing in the River Dyje near the city of Břeclav (48°80′N; 16°84′E; the Morava River basin).
statement: Fish were caught using electrofishing in the River Dyje.
text_en: Fish were caught using electrofishing in the River Dyje.

quote: In conclusion, the results of the current study demonstrated that supplementation with 5′-IMP can promote feed utilization and growth of gibel carp.
statement: 总之，本研究的结果表明，补充5'-IMP可以促进银鲫的饲料利用率和生长。
text_zh: 总之，本研究的结果表明，补充5'-IMP可以促进银鲫的饲料利用率和生长。
text_en: In conclusion, the results of this study indicate that supplementation with 5'-IMP can promote feed utilization and growth in gibel carp.

quote: supplementation with 5′-IMP could improve the osmoregulatory adaptation of gibel carp under acute salinity stress by modulating Na + /K + ATPase activity and the expression of NKCC, NKA α1a and NKA α1b
statement: 补充5'-IMP可以通过调节Na+/K+ ATP酶活性以及NKCC、NKA α1a和NKA α1b的表达来改善急性盐度胁迫下鲫鱼的渗透压调节适应能力。
text_zh: 补充5'-IMP可以通过调节Na+/K+ ATP酶活性以及NKCC、NKA α1a和NKA α1b的表达来改善急性盐度胁迫下鲫鱼的渗透压调节适应能力。
text_en: Supplementation with 5'-IMP can improve the osmoregulatory adaptation ability of crucian carp under acute salinity stress by regulating Na+/K+ ATPase activity and the expression of NKCC, NKA α1a, and NKA α1b.

quote: it can promote oxidative-stress resistance by increasing the gene expression of Keap1/Nrf2 pathway-related antioxidants, including SOD, CAT, GSH-PX and MPO
statement: 它可以通过增加Keap1/Nrf2通路相关抗氧化剂（包括SOD、CAT、GSH-PX和MPO）的基因表达来促进氧化应激抵抗力。
text_zh: 它可以通过增加Keap1/Nrf2通路相关抗氧化剂（包括SOD、CAT、GSH-PX和MPO）的基因表达来促进氧化应激抵抗力。
text_en: It can promote oxidative stress resistance by increasing the gene expression of antioxidants related to the Keap1/Nrf2 pathway (including SOD, CAT, GSH-PX, and MPO).

quote: Total parasite abundance as well as monogenean parasite abundance was lower in gynogenetic G07 haplotypes when compared to other haplotypes (Mann–Whitney test, p = 0.018 and p = 0.008, resp.).
statement: 与单倍型G07相比，其他单倍型的总寄生虫丰度和单殖吸虫寄生虫丰度更高。
text_zh: 与单倍型G07相比，其他单倍型的总寄生虫丰度和单殖吸虫寄生虫丰度更高。
text_en: Compared to haplotype G07, other haplotypes had higher total parasite abundance and monogenean parasite abundance.

quote: An increase in NKA α1b mRNA transcription during seawater transfer has also been observed in several salmonid species [ 49 ] as well as in other teleosts, such as the perch Anabas testudineus [ 50 ] and the inanga Galaxias maculatus [ 51 ].
statement: 在多种鲑科鱼类及其他硬骨鱼中，海水转移期间观察到NKA α1b mRNA转录增加。
text_zh: 在多种鲑科鱼类及其他硬骨鱼中，海水转移期间观察到NKA α1b mRNA转录增加。
text_en: In various salmonid fish and other teleosts, increased NKA α1b mRNA transcription was observed during seawater transfer.
